authority: authoring-template-only; not evidence until generated from actual lanes
required_generation: Register every active lane exactly once with owned paths, target freshness, actor binding, and teardown rules.

Every active lane must receive an operational objective packet before work starts or before a send-back steer: product-behavior objective, owned/forbidden authority, behavior rows, positive current-candidate proof or verified current-input reuse, negative false-pass proof, independent reconciliation, old-surface disposition, reviewer packet, parent reruns, blocker movement, claim ceiling, and unsupported claims.

Each behavior row must be evaluable as pass, partial, or blocked from exact commands, source paths, output fields, and falsification cases; broad prose, tests-only evidence, receipt existence, generated rows, or local JSON are not enough.

Parent acceptance must reject missing behavior rows, missing product run or verified reuse chain, missing negative falsification, missing old-surface disposition, missing reviewer packet, or unclear claim ceiling.
Terminal lanes require merge/supersession/abandonment evidence and cleanup receipts.
Do not treat status complete as merged.
